name: Leo Ho
title: Analyst Programmer

intro.headline: From complex problems to working software.
intro.description: I build production software and tools for AI-assisted development. Alongside my work in healthcare technology, I’m exploring ideas through side projects and plugins.

about.lead: I like making complicated things easier to work with.
paragraphs: For the past four years, I’ve worked on clinic-management software used by more than 600 clinics and 2,000 doctors. My work spans understanding requirements, shaping technical solutions, writing code, testing, and seeing changes through to production.
I’m equally interested in how software gets built: reusable architecture, thoughtful code reviews, reliable tests, and practical ways to bring AI into the development process.
about.heading: A builder’s mindset.

experience.description: Building clinical workflows, reusable components, and integrations for a clinic-management platform. Supporting engineering quality through code review, mentoring, and automated testing.
Built reusable Flutter widgets for an internal mobile prototype and worked on an Angular back-office system.

contact.label: Keep in touch
contact.heading: Good things start with a conversation.

footer: Made with curiosity. Built to keep growing.
